name: learner
description: Turns Claude Code into a learning loop: quizzes you on your own diffs, tracks weak spots per developer, and (opt-in) scores how much of the thinking on a task you delegate versus do yourself.

github_token.title: GitHub token for sync
github_token.description: Personal access token learner sync uses to create and update its one secret gist. A fine-grained token with only the Gists permission (read and write) is enough. Learner never reads the credential gh keeps on this machine; leave empty and sync stays off.

machine_name.title: Machine name for sync
machine_name.description: Label recorded as pushedFrom when learner sync pushes your learning record to its gist, so you can tell machines apart. Leave empty to record "unknown". Learner never reads your hostname.
